pick.name: Cloudflare R2
pick.why: Zero egress fees on every class; same account as Workers
pick.free_limits: 10 GB-month, 1M Class A, 10M Class B per month free; then $0.015/GB-mo; egress free

alts.name: Backblaze B2
alts.why: Best second location for backups (different vendor)
alts.free_limits: First 10 GB free; $6.95/TB-mo; free egress up to 3x stored

candidates.name: Cloudflare R2
candidates.verdict: PICK: no egress fees, 10 GB free

candidates.name: Backblaze B2
candidates.verdict: Alt: cheapest per TB, good backup target

candidates.name: AWS S3
candidates.verdict: Egress costs; no always-free tier now

candidates.name: Neon Object Storage
candidates.verdict: 5 GB/project on free per pricing page; new

decision: R2 is the default because egress is free and it lives next to Workers. Keep a second copy of backups on B2 so one vendor outage/lockout doesn't take everything.
